aurora.zh: 进攻端最常用 B 点爆弹：B连接烟、警家烟与 B后点火，5 次赢 4 次。防守端不堆点（0%，其他队伍 11%），开局 20 秒常规站位 A1 M1 B3，但及时回防仅 20%，低于其他队伍的 48%。
aurora.en: Go-to execute is B with Palace smoke, CT smoke and Back site molotov (5 times, won 4). On CT they almost never stack (0% vs 11%) and default to A1 M1 B3 at 20 s, but rotate in time in only 20% of rounds versus 48%.

betboom.zh: 防守端偏爱堆点，26% 的枪局选择堆点，远高于其他队伍的 9%（19 个枪局）。
betboom.en: On CT they stack a site in 26% of gun rounds versus 9% for other teams (19 gun rounds).

falcons.zh: 进攻端最常用 B 点爆弹：B连接烟、警家烟与 B后点火，17 次赢 12 次。NiKo 是最常摸边的人，14 次进攻时身处另一侧或远离进攻点。
falcons.en: Go-to execute is B with Palace smoke, CT smoke and Back site molotov (17 times, won 12), and NiKo is the usual lurker (14 hits with him on the other side or far away).

flyquest.zh: jks 是最常摸边的人，4 次进攻时身处另一侧或远离进攻点。
flyquest.en: jks is the usual lurker (4 hits with him on the other side or far away).

g2.zh: 进攻端快攻占 30%（其他队伍 12%），分兵进点只有 29%，低于其他队伍的 62%。防守端开局 20 秒常摆 A1 M2 B2，占 29% 的枪局，胜率 80%。
g2.en: Fast hits are 30% of their rounds (12% for others) and splits only 29% (62% for others); on CT the default is A1 M2 B2 at 20 s, 29% of gun rounds with 80% won.

natus-vincere.zh: 进攻端偏慢，拖后进攻占 55%（其他队伍 35%），常用 A 点爆弹：天堂烟、A连接烟、A连接火与 A包点火，4 次赢 3 次。防守端开局前压占 27%，高于其他队伍的 14%。
natus-vincere.en: Late hits are 55% of their rounds (35% for others), built on the A execute with Heaven smoke, A connector smoke, A connector molotov and A site molotov (4 times, won 3). On CT an early push shows up in 27% of rounds versus 14%.

spirit.zh: zont1x 是最常摸边的人，7 次进攻时身处另一侧或远离进攻点。防守端开局 20 秒常摆 A2 M1 B2，占 33% 的枪局，胜率 64%。
spirit.en: zont1x is the usual lurker (7 hits with him on the other side or far away); on CT the default is A2 M1 B2 at 20 s, 33% of gun rounds with 64% won.

tyloo.zh: 拖后进攻只占 10%，远低于其他队伍的 38%。防守端开局 20 秒常摆 A2 M1 B2，占 40% 的枪局，胜率 67%。
tyloo.en: Late hits are only 10% of their rounds (38% for others); on CT the default is A2 M1 B2 at 20 s, 40% of gun rounds with 67% won.

vitality.zh: 最常用的爆弹是 B 点警家烟（B点），4 次赢 3 次。
vitality.en: Go-to execute is B with CT smoke (B) (4 times, won 3).
